name: Paschalis II
pdTranslations: Letters available through Epistolae project (epistolae.ctl.columbia.edu) with partial English translations from secondary source collections
modernTranslations: Limited; some letters translated via Epistolae database but no comprehensive modern edition
untranslatedHighlights: Epistolae et Privilegia collection largely untranslated

name: Sedulius Scotus
modernTranslations: E.G. Doyle, 'On Christian Rulers and The Poems' (Medieval & Renaissance Texts & Studies 17, 1983); R.W. Dyson, 'De Rectoribus Christianis [On Christian Rulers]: An Edition and English Translation' (2009)
untranslatedHighlights: Major works (De rectoribus Christianis, Carmina) well-covered by modern translations

name: Coelestinus III
modernTranslations: Decretals incorporated into canonical collections; individual letters available in compilations but no standalone modern English translation
untranslatedHighlights: Complete papal correspondence remains largely untranslated

name: Wibaldus Corbeiensis
modernTranslations: 400+ letters survive in Codex epistolaris Wibaldi; some translated via medieval sources compilations but comprehensive translation not confirmed
untranslatedHighlights: Extensive epistolary archive (400+ letters) status unclear; administrative/political content from imperial chancery

name: Venantius Fortunatus
pdTranslations: John Mason Neale hymn translations (19th century) - 'Sing My Tongue the Glorious Battle', 'The Royal Banners Forward Go'
modernTranslations: Michael Roberts, 'Poems' (Dumbarton Oaks Medieval Library 46, 2017) - complete translation of all 11 books except one saint's life poem
untranslatedHighlights: One long saint's life poem remains untranslated; otherwise comprehensively rendered

name: Benedictus Anianensis
pdTranslations: Excerpts from Concordia regularum available in secondary sources
modernTranslations: Allen Cabaniss, 'Benedict of Aniane: The Emperor's Monk' (Cistercian Studies 220, trans. with Clemens Radl & Annette Grabowski); partial translation of Concordia regularum
untranslatedHighlights: Capitulare Institutum, complete Concordia regularum remain largely untranslated

name: Freculphus Lexovensis
modernTranslations: Michael I. Allen, 'Frechulfus Lexouiensis episcopi Opera omnia' (Corpus Christianorum Continuatio Mediaeualis, 2002) - critical edition in Latin; Graeme Ward, 'History, Scripture, and Authority in the Carolingian Empire: Frechulf of Lisieux' (Oxford, 2022) - scholarly study, not translation
untranslatedHighlights: Twelve Books of Histories (Historiarum libri XII) - major Carolingian universal chronicle - no English translation located

name: Arnobius junior
modernTranslations: Guido Stucco, 'Praedestinatus' (Brepols, 2022) - first English translation; Commentary on Psalms translation status unclear
untranslatedHighlights: Commentary on Psalms and other theological writings - translation status uncertain

name: Munio Mindoniensis
modernTranslations: No English translation found; Historia Compostellana (co-authored) appears in Patrologia Latina 170 but translation status not established
untranslatedHighlights: Historia Compostellana and other works - no confirmed English translation

name: Albericus Aquensis
modernTranslations: Susan B. Edgington, 'Albert of Aachen's History of the Journey to Jerusalem' (Crusade Texts in Translation 24-25, 2013) - complete translation of Historia Hierosolymitanae Expeditionis
untranslatedHighlights: Primary work (Historia) comprehensively translated; other minor works status unclear

name: Agnellus Ravennatensis
modernTranslations: Deborah Mauskopf Deliyannis, 'The Book of Pontiffs of the Church of Ravenna' (Medieval Texts in Translation, 2004) - complete English translation of Liber Pontificalis Ravennatis
untranslatedHighlights: Liber Pontificalis well-covered; other minor works status less clear

name: Sozomenus
pdTranslations: Edward Walford translation, 'The Ecclesiastical History of Sozomen' (1855)
modernTranslations: Chester D. Hartranft, 'Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers' Second Series Vol. 2 (1890); modern editions include Byzantine translation projects
untranslatedHighlights: None - work comprehensively translated and frequently anthologized

name: Marius Victorinus
modernTranslations: Stephen Andrew Cooper, 'Marius Victorinus' Commentary on Galatians' (Oxford Early Christian Studies, 2005); Sister Mary T. Clark, 'Theological Treatises on the Trinity' (Fathers of the Church, 1981)
untranslatedHighlights: Secular works (Ars grammatica, Cicero commentaries, logic treatises) appear untranslated; philosophical/theological commentaries on Paul partially covered

name: Facundus Hermianensis
modernTranslations: Anne Fraïsse-Bétoulières, 'Defense des trois chapitres (A Justinien)' (Sources Chretiennes, 2002-2006) - French translation only; no English translation located
untranslatedHighlights: Primary apologetic work (Defense of Three Chapters) translated to French but not English

name: Ado Viennensis
modernTranslations: No English translation located; works published in Patrologia Latina and Monumenta Germaniae Historica in Latin only
untranslatedHighlights: Chronicon (Breviarium chronicorum) and Martyrologium remain untranslated; based on Bede's chronicle with original synthesis

name: Ludovicus Pius
modernTranslations: Thomas F.X. Noble, 'The Life of Emperor Louis' (Pennsylvania, 2009) - English translation of Vita Hludovici by the Astronomer; other royal/administrative documents status varies
untranslatedHighlights: Ordinatio Imperii (817) and Gesta Hludovici (by Thegan of Trier) - some translated, comprehensive corpus not confirmed

name: Julianus Toletanus
modernTranslations: Sergio Stancati, 'Prognosticum futuri saeculi: Foreknowledge of the World to Come' (Ancient Christian Writers 63, 2010); other works (Historia Wambae, theological treatises) status unclear
untranslatedHighlights: Historia Wambae and De Comprobatione Aetatis Sextae Contra Judaeos remain untranslated

name: Regino Prumiensis
modernTranslations: Simon MacLean, 'History and Politics in Late Carolingian and Ottonian Europe: The Chronicle of Regino of Prüm and Adalbert of Magdeburg' (Manchester Medieval Sources, 2009) - complete English translation; Wilfried Hartmann, 'Libri duo de synodalibus causis' (Monumenta Germaniae Historica, 2023) - edited and translated
untranslatedHighlights: Chronicle (Chronicon) and synodal handbook (Sendhandbuch/Libri duo) both translated

name: Gillebertus de Hoilandia
modernTranslations: Lawrence C. Braceland, 'Sermons on the Song of Songs' (4 vols., Cistercian Publications, 1978-1981) and 'Treatises, Sermons and Epistles' (Cistercian Publications, 1980); Pierre-Yves Emery, French translations
untranslatedHighlights: Major works comprehensively translated; some minor treatises and letters may remain in Latin only

name: Thomas Cantuariensis
modernTranslations: Anne Duggan (ed.), 'The Correspondence of Thomas Becket, Archbishop of Canterbury' (2 vols., Clarendon Press/Oxford, 2000) - comprehensive collection of letters in English translation; contemporary biographies by John of Salisbury, Edward Grim, Benedict of Peterborough, etc. translated
untranslatedHighlights: Letters (1162-1170) well-covered; biographical material via contemporary accounts; any separate theological/administrative writings status less clear
